intitule: Cybersecurity and Digital Sovereignty Project Manager
accroche: With a technical background and as a French Army reserve officer, I connect public-sector missions, cybersecurity and the teams that deliver.
resume: I have been a senior project manager at Capgemini since 2020, running digital projects for French government ministries and the public sector: application development, cyber risk assessments, architecture studies and sovereign solutions. I have led more than 30 projects worth €500k to €2M each, and I currently run three to seven at once with five to ten people.

Sovereignty sits at the heart of this work. The question is whether to use a SecNumCloud-qualified trusted cloud or an on-premise deployment at the client's site, and then to back that choice with a risk assessment the decision-makers can follow. I take each engagement from scoping to delivery and I am accountable for the client, the budget, the contract and the teams.

As a reserve Lieutenant in the French Army, deployed for three months on an overseas operation, I know the missions my projects serve from the inside. My background combines technical training in electrical engineering and computing, business school with a year in Mexico, leading student associations and two years at JCDecaux. It left me with a method: understand the mission, talk technology with the teams, report plainly to decision-makers.
